answer:
The Beat note now has a drum machine on its App side.

- **Playing:** Press Play to hear the pattern loop. The current step is highlighted, and Stop ends it. The tempo slider starts at the "120 bpm" in your note. The app remembers the setting but doesn't write it back to the note text.
- **Editing:** Each sound (Kick, Snare, Hat) is a row of steps. Tap a step to turn it on or off, and you'll hear that sound as you do. Every tap edits the table in the note, so the Text side always shows the current pattern as x marks. Edits you make to the table by hand show up in the app.
- **Sounds:** They're synthesized in the app, with no samples. A column with an unfamiliar name gets a simple beep, so you can add one to the table.

The final check flagged one item: the screen has several stacked sections. I left that because a drum machine works best on a single screen. The other layout and contrast issues are fixed. I haven't heard it play myself, so give it a try.
